import sys

def solve():
    mod = 998244353
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    m = int(sys.stdin.readline())

    def invl(a, mod):
        b = mod
        p = 1
        q = 0
        while b > 0:
            c = a // b
            d = a
            a = b
            b = d % b
            d = p
            p = q
            q = d - c * q
        return p % mod

    ans = (1 + invl(m+1, mod) * n) % mod
    base = (invl(m+1, mod) * ((m * (m+2 + (n-1))) % mod)) % mod
    u = 0
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        u += invl(i, mod)
        u %= mod

    ans = (base * u + ans) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
